parameters.primary: connected components of >=50% identity among aligned residue-residue positions AND >=80% residue-residue alignment coverage of both sequences
parameters.embedded_domain_guard: for length ratio <80%, shorter length >=40aa, require >=70% identity over aligned positions and >=90% coverage of shorter sequence
parameters.source_name_unions: explicit recognizable lineage/published-scaffold name rules only; author or tool alone not used
parameters.caveat: Operational conservative sequence/scaffold family proxies, not certified evolutionary families. Some unrelated antibody clones share framework and intentionally remain together. Distant shared topology can remain undetected.
